messages:
Maya Chen: Dropping a quick thread after today's sync. Uploaded new frames for the batch vectors preview + rerank export flow: https://figma.redwood/vec-preview-v3. Asking for copy + a11y + small mobile behavior pass. Key things: multi-select toolbar, relevance-score column, CSV header mapping modal, and export confirmation microcopy.

Eliot Brooks: Skimmed the frames — nice job. Two immediate things: 1) When users change the rerank weight slider, the relevance score column updates live. We should warn about this in the export modal (so exports aren't surprising). 2) The CSV column picker defaults to `auto` mapping; that hides the original text column. Suggest showing a preview of the first 3 rows.

Nina Shah: Copy suggestion for the live update warning: `Relevance scores will update as you adjust rerank settings. Exported CSV will include the final values.` Short and direct. Put it under the export header in smaller gray text.

Carlos Mendez: Accessibility: the rerank slider needs aria-valuetext describing the numeric weight and the resulting label (e.g., "rerank weight: 0.6 — prioritizes semantic similarity"). Also when the column updates, announce "Relevance scores updated" with a polite live region.

Maya Chen: Good tip. Also thinking about the toolbar: on mobile we currently collapse actions behind a kebab. That hides the reorder action, which is a primary in rerank flows. Proposal: keep Reorder and Export visible; push Share/Copy link into overflow.

Eliot Brooks: Agree. For compact toolbar state I mocked two options: stacked two-line toolbar (action row + counter row) vs condensed single-line with icons + count chip. Preferences? The stacked feels more stable for touch targets.

Nina Shah: Stacked is more accessible — larger touch areas and consistent order. If we do stacked, ensure the count chip has at least 12px vertical padding and 4.5:1 contrast.

DesignOps: Quick note: telemetry-wise, we want the export CTA label to be stable for A/B analysis. If we add dynamic counts into the CTA text, make sure the telemetry records a normalized event (e.g., export_vectors.click with metadata.count).

Carlos Mendez: Keyboard behavior for the column picker modal: focus should land on the first selectable column checkbox. Arrow keys should navigate the list; Space toggles. Add `aria-describedby` to explain `Press Space to select multiple` when multi-select is enabled.

Maya Chen: For the CSV header naming UI, the current placeholder says `Auto-detect`. Suggest change to `Auto-detected header: text` so it's explicit. Also add an `Edit` affordance inline for advanced users.

Eliot Brooks: UX nit: when user reorders columns in preview, the header mapping modal should reflect that new order — they shouldn't have to remap manually. Sync state two-way.

Nina Shah: Accessibility edge: VoiceOver on iOS reads the relevance column values but not the column label when swiping columns. Ensure `aria-label` is applied to the header cell (`role=columnheader aria-label="Relevance score, higher is more relevant"`).

Carlos Mendez: On export confirmation copy: current text is `Export items?` — too vague. Suggest `Export 12 vectors as CSV (includes text, id, relevance_score)` and a smaller `You can customize columns in the mapping modal.` below.

Maya Chen: Love that. Also, add an unobtrusive inline link in the modal: `What does relevance_score mean?` that opens a tooltip with a short explanation and a link to docs.

Eliot Brooks: For large selections (1000+), we should surface an async export note: `This export will be processed in the background. We'll email you when it's ready.` And disable the modal confirm CTA to avoid repeated clicks until the job is scheduled.

Nina Shah: A11y-bot: small checklist to include in PR: 1) header labels have descriptive aria-labels; 2) live region announces `N vectors selected` and `Relevance scores updated`; 3) focus trap in export modal; 4) keyboard-only flow for rerank slider + annotations; 5) contrast checks for chips and sliders.

DesignOps: I'll add telemetry events needed for export_type, count, and async flag. Also flagging retention for exported CSVs in the privacy doc.

Maya Chen: Action items from thread: @Nina — write aria-labels and a short tooltip text (2 sentences max); @Eliot — attach stacked toolbar frames + mobile touch spec; @Carlos — add aria-valuetext slider examples and live-region snippet; @DesignOps — add telemetry events to the spec. I'll consolidate and push updated frames by Thursday lunchtime.

Eliot Brooks: Will do.

Nina Shah: On it.

Carlos Mendez: I'll prototype the live region clearing pattern to avoid duplicate reads.

Maya Chen: Thanks team — ping me for quick sync if anything blocks. :sparkles:
